style: Playwright-generated Edo ink-wash sprite sheets — detailed canvas-rendered character art with kimono folds, weapons, hats, and woodblock grain background

musashi.description: Miyamoto Musashi — wide-brimmed kasa hat, topknot, haori jacket, katana at hip, hakama pants. Idle hand-on-katana pose, diagonal slash sweep, raised block, damage stagger.

koeda.description: Koeda, runner of bridges — lean build, short hair, long trailing scarf, ink brush at hip. Arm-sweep slash, arms-crossed block.

yoshino.description: Yoshino, carver of rain — hooded sage robe, staff, wide silhouette. Staff sweep slash, staff block.

chaser.description: Dock ronin (chaser) — monk-like hat, simple robe, staff weapon.

prowler.description: Cedar bandit (prowler) — bandit hat, rough robe, hatchet blade.

duelist.description: Bridge duelist (duelist) — red headband, armor-like shoulders, long sword.

vagrant.description: Straw-hat vagrant — wide straw hat, wanderer's robe, simple sword.

monk.description: River-bank monk — grey cowl, robe, naginata polearm.

ganryu.description: Ganryu — imposing samurai, wide dark hat, yoroi shoulder armor, large nodachi sword.
